title: A Case Study in Assuring AI-Written Software

paragraphs.en: Managing Agents that Manage Agents: Workshop on Responsible Use of Meta-Agents
paragraphs.zh: 管理智能体的智能体：元智能体负责任使用研讨会

paragraphs.en: Software-engineering agents can enable people without formal software training to build systems they could not otherwise implement and simultaneously can produce more code than even experts can meaningfully inspect. In both cases, exhaustive code review is not reliable as the sole basis for human control. We report a case study of a production healthcare platform built through coding agents and governed by an operator without formal software-engineering training. Over time, its workflow grew into a human-led meta-agent system where one agent wrote code, other agents supervised and reviewed it, and project rules carried lessons forward. The operator found that tests, monitors and reviewing agents used to supervise the system were fallible. Some monitors measured proxies rather than outcomes, some audits failed silently, missing checks disappeared from reported results and one automated repair caused operational disruption. In this case, human control depended on keeping the intended outcome, the evidence used to judge it, the agents’ permissions and the final human decision were all tied to the same underlying objective.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体能让没有正式软件培训的人构建他们原本无法实现的系统，同时还能生成比专家能够有效审查的更多的代码。 在这两种情况下，彻底的代码审查都不能作为人类控制的唯一可靠依据。 我们报告了一个案例研究：一个生产级的医疗平台通过编码智能体构建，并由一名没有正式软件工程培训的操作员进行管理。 随着时间的推移，其工作流程逐渐发展成一个由人类主导的元智能体系统：一个智能体编写代码，其他智能体对其进行监督与审查，而项目规则则不断传承经验教训。 操作员发现，用于监督系统的测试、监控器和审查智能体都存在失误的可能性。 一些监控器衡量的是代理指标而非实际结果，一些审计未能及时发出警报，某些检查项从报告结果中消失，还有一个自动修复程序甚至引发了运行中断。 在这种情况下，人类控制依赖于将预期目标、用于判断目标的证据、智能体的权限以及最终的人类决策全部与同一个底层目标紧密绑定。

paragraphs.en: Despite the name, a coding ‘agent’ is really a loop of interacting processes in which a model proposes an action, a harness executes it through tools and returns an observation, and the model iterates until the task is submitted or terminated ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Its reliability ultimately depends on whether the generated code produces the outcome the user wanted. But when the request is underspecified or the outcome is difficult to measure (i.e. “a pretty website”), the model cannot directly optimize for it. In practice, direct line by line code review of the model output is often treated as the main form of human oversight. However, recent work suggests that experienced developers instead control coding agents through prompting, planning approval, and validation ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . One participant in a practitioner study reported that a week’s commits had grown from a few hundred lines before coding agents to 10–20K after, while another described pull-request backlogs because generation outpaced review ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) . Another study found that coding agents improved initial task completion but reduced code comprehension, and their initial advantage largely disappeared on a later extension task completed without the coding agent ( Balepur et al., 2026 ) . These results do not make source review obsolete, but they motivate complementary controls when exhaustive inspection cannot keep pace.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管名称如此，编码“智能体”实际上是一系列相互作用的流程循环：模型提出一个动作，执行器通过工具执行该动作并返回观察结果，然后模型不断迭代，直到任务提交或终止（Yang et al., 2024）。 其可靠性最终取决于生成的代码是否能产生用户期望的结果。 但如果需求描述不充分，或者结果难以衡量（例如“一个美观的网站”），模型就无法直接针对该目标进行优化。 在实践中，对模型输出逐行进行直接代码审查通常被视为主要的人工监督形式。 然而，近期的研究指出，经验丰富的开发者实际上是通过提示、规划审批和验证来控制编码智能体的（Huang et al., 2025）。 一项针对从业者的研究中，一位参与者报告称，使用编码智能体前每周提交的代码仅有几百行，使用后则增长到1万至2万行；另一位参与者则提到，由于生成速度超过了审查速度，导致拉取请求积压（Lyu et al., 2026）。 另一项研究发现，编码智能体虽然提升了初始任务的完成度，但降低了代码的可理解性；在后续一个无需使用编码智能体的扩展任务中，其最初的优势基本消失（Balepur et al., 2026）。 这些结果并未使源代码审查变得过时，但它们表明，当全面检查无法跟上开发速度时，需要引入补充的控制措施。

paragraphs.en: There is a useful historical precedent. FORTRAN replaced large amounts of hand-written machine code with automatic translation and widened access to programming ( Backus et al., 1957 ) . As checking every generated machine instruction became less practical, assurance shifted toward correctness proofs ( McCarthy and Painter, 1967 ) , conformance test suites ( Holberton and Parker, 1973 ) , per-translation validation ( Pnueli et al., 1998 ) , verified compilers ( Leroy, 2009 ) and randomized differential testing ( Yang et al., 2011 ) . Coding agents are not compilers: they infer underspecified intent, act in stateful environments and may modify their own tests. They are also often proprietary and difficult to inspect directly. The analogy is limited, but the precedent is still useful: when direct inspection becomes impractical, assurance may need to move elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 存在一个有用的历史先例。 FORTRAN 用自动翻译取代了大量手写机器码，并扩大了编程的普及性（Backus 等，1957）。 随着对每个生成的机器指令进行验证变得越来越不切实际，保障重点转向了正确性证明（McCarthy 和 Painter，1967）、合规测试套件（Holberton 和 Parker，1973）、每次翻译后的验证（Pnueli 等，1998）、经过验证的编译器（Leroy，2009）以及随机化差异测试（Yang 等，2011）。 编码智能体并非编译器：它们会推断未完全说明的意图，在具有状态的环境中进行操作，并可能修改自身的测试。 此外，它们通常属于专有技术，难以直接检查。 这种类比存在局限性，但该先例仍然有用：当直接检查变得不切实际时，保障可能需要转向其他途径。

paragraphs.en: We examine this question through a boundary case in which an operator without formal SE training used a coding agent as the primary developer of a production healthcare platform that she could not have implemented alone. Because exhaustive source-code review was not a realistic form of oversight, the case provides an opportunity to study what other forms of control emerged in practice. The supervisory workflow was not designed in advance. It developed through trial and error as failures revealed weaknesses and prompted new checks and review practices. Recent research provides the language of evaluation-driven development for describing parts of this evolving workflow ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个边界案例来探讨这个问题：一名没有接受过正式软件工程培训的操作员，使用了一个编码智能体作为生产级医疗平台的主要开发者，而该平台她独自一人根本无法实现。 由于对源代码进行全面审查并非一种现实的监督方式，这个案例为我们研究实践中出现了哪些其他形式的控制机制提供了机会。 这种监督工作流程并非事先设计好的。 它是在不断尝试和错误中逐步形成的：每次失败都会暴露出薄弱环节，并促使人们引入新的检查与审查方法。 近期的研究为描述这一不断演变的工作流程中的某些环节，提供了以评估为导向的开发相关术语（Xia et al., 2025; Lyu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Using two structured interviews with the operator together with project records, we examine two questions: RQ1: Where did human control reside when implementation and review were delegated to agents? RQ2: What did the resulting checks and reviewing agents contribute, and where did they fail?
paragraphs.zh: 通过结合对操作员的两次结构化访谈与项目记录，我们探讨了两个问题：研究问题1（RQ1）：当实施和审查工作被委托给智能体时，人类控制权究竟体现在何处？ 研究问题2（RQ2）：由此产生的检查环节以及负责审查的智能体发挥了哪些作用，又在哪些方面出现了不足？

sents.en: Using two structured interviews with the operator together with project records, we examine two questions: RQ1: Where did human control reside when implementation and review were delegated to agents?
sents.zh: 通过结合对操作员的两次结构化访谈与项目记录，我们探讨了两个问题：研究问题1（RQ1）：当实施和审查工作被委托给智能体时，人类控制权究竟体现在何处？

sents.en: RQ2: What did the resulting checks and reviewing agents contribute, and where did they fail?
sents.zh: 研究问题2（RQ2）：由此产生的检查环节以及负责审查的智能体发挥了哪些作用，又在哪些方面出现了不足？

paragraphs.en: This retrospective case study draws on two structured interviews with the operator, conducted in June and August 2026, together with project records spanning six months. The records included decision logs, audit reports, incident records, check inventories and working notes. We reconstructed the development and assurance workflow from these sources and identified incidents in which an assurance mechanism produced incomplete or misleading evidence. Interview claims were cross-checked against available project records where possible.
paragraphs.zh: 这项回顾性案例研究基于对操作员在2026年6月和8月进行的两次结构化访谈，以及为期六个月的项目记录。 这些记录包括决策日志、审计报告、事件记录、检查清单和工作笔记。 我们根据这些资料重建了开发与保障工作流程，并识别出保障机制产生不完整或误导性证据的事件。 在可能的情况下，我们将访谈中的陈述与现有的项目记录进行了交叉验证。

sents.zh: 这项回顾性案例研究基于对操作员在2026年6月和8月进行的两次结构化访谈，以及为期六个月的项目记录。

sents.en: Interview claims were cross-checked against available project records where possible.
sents.zh: 在可能的情况下，我们将访谈中的陈述与现有的项目记录进行了交叉验证。

paragraphs.en: The platform supported the business operations of a healthcare practice, including note-taking support, scheduling and payroll workflows, alongside background functions such as access control, backups and audits. Some parts were easy for the operator to inspect: she could try a page or workflow in staging and judge whether it behaved as intended. Other properties were largely hidden from her. She could not directly see whether a backup was usable or whether an audit had run completely. Requirements of a regulated healthcare setting (US health-privacy law) applied, although we do not assess compliance. For context, the HIPAA Security Rule sets administrative, physical and technical safeguards for electronic protected health information, and NIST SP 800-66 provides implementation guidance ( U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 2026 ; Marron, 2024 ) . Coding agents could access repositories, test data and staging systems, but production data was kept outside their reach through the system architecture and file and folder permissions.
paragraphs.zh: 该平台支持医疗诊所的业务运营，包括笔记记录支持、日程安排和薪资工作流程，以及访问控制、备份和审计等后台功能。其中某些部分便于操作员检查：她可以在预发布环境中测试某个页面或工作流程，并判断其运行是否符合预期。但其他特性对她而言基本是隐藏的。她无法直接查看备份是否可用，或审计是否已完整执行。受监管的医疗环境（美国健康隐私法）的相关要求同样适用，尽管我们并未评估其合规性。作为背景信息，《HIPAA 安全规则》为电子受保护健康信息设定了管理、物理和技术方面的安全措施，而 NIST SP 800-66 提供了实施指南（美国卫生与公众服务部，2026；Marron，2024）。编码智能体可以访问代码库、测试数据和预发布系统，但通过系统架构以及文件和文件夹权限设置，生产数据被限制在它们无法触及的范围内。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the full workflow. At the start of each session, the primary coding agent re-read a versioned project rulebook, current task and issue lists and reusable skill files, allowing project context and recurring procedures to carry across otherwise fresh sessions. As she explained, “That’s how the lessons and unfinished work stick even though each session starts fresh.” The operator described the feature she wanted and approved or revised the proposed approach before implementation. Changes then passed project tests, were reviewed by a separate agent in a fresh context and were deployed to private staging for human inspection. The separate reviewer functioned as an LLM critic ( McAleese et al., 2024 ) . The operator could also commission broader fresh context meta-audits that were not tied to a particular code change. These audits used newly instantiated agents without the primary development conversation to inspect wider parts of the system and its records for problems missed by the normal development loop. Their findings entered the same process of remediation, regression testing and reusable lessons.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了完整的工作流程。 每次会话开始时，主编码智能体都会重新阅读一个带版本的项目规则手册、当前任务和问题列表以及可重用的技能文件，从而让项目上下文和重复性流程在原本全新的会话中得以延续。 她解释道：“正因如此，尽管每次会话都从头开始，但学到的经验和未完成的工作仍然能够保留下来。”操作者描述了所需的功能，并在实施前批准或修改了建议的方案。 随后，这些变更通过了项目测试，由另一个智能体在全新的上下文中进行审查，并被部署到私有预发布环境以供人工检查。 这个独立的审查器充当了一个大型语言模型批评者（McAleese 等，2024）。 操作者还可以发起更广泛的、基于全新上下文的元审计，这些审计不针对任何特定的代码变更。 这些审计使用了新实例化的智能体，它们不参与主开发对话，而是用于检查系统的更广泛部分及其记录中常规开发流程可能遗漏的问题。 它们的发现将进入相同的修复、回归测试和可重用经验总结流程。

sents.zh: 图 1 展示了完整的工作流程。

sents.en: At the start of each session, the primary coding agent re-read a versioned project rulebook, current task and issue lists and reusable skill files, allowing project context and recurring procedures to carry across otherwise fresh sessions.
sents.zh: 每次会话开始时，主编码智能体都会重新阅读一个带版本的项目规则手册、当前任务和问题列表以及可重用的技能文件，从而让项目上下文和重复性流程在原本全新的会话中得以延续。

sents.en: As she explained, “That’s how the lessons and unfinished work stick even though each session starts fresh.” The operator described the feature she wanted and approved or revised the proposed approach before implementation.
sents.zh: 她解释道：“正因如此，尽管每次会话都从头开始，但学到的经验和未完成的工作仍然能够保留下来。”操作者描述了所需的功能，并在实施前批准或修改了建议的方案。

sents.en: Changes then passed project tests, were reviewed by a separate agent in a fresh context and were deployed to private staging for human inspection.
sents.zh: 随后，这些变更通过了项目测试，由另一个智能体在全新的上下文中进行审查，并被部署到私有预发布环境以供人工检查。

sents.en: The separate reviewer functioned as an LLM critic ( McAleese et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 这个独立的审查器充当了一个大型语言模型批评者（McAleese 等，2024）。

sents.en: The operator could also commission broader fresh context meta-audits that were not tied to a particular code change.
sents.zh: 操作者还可以发起更广泛的、基于全新上下文的元审计，这些审计不针对任何特定的代码变更。

sents.en: Their findings entered the same process of remediation, regression testing and reusable lessons.
sents.zh: 它们的发现将进入相同的修复、回归测试和可重用经验总结流程。

paragraphs.en: For difficult decisions, the operator could invoke a multi-model council. Models from several providers independently answered the same brief without seeing one another’s responses and returned their recommendations, reasons and risks for the operator to consider. Confirmed failures were used to search for similar problems elsewhere in the codebase and, where appropriate, to add regression tests. Agents could also propose reusable lessons at the end of a session; approved lessons were stored for use in later sessions. Production data was inaccessible to the coding agents, and changes reached production only after staging and explicit operator approval.
paragraphs.zh: 对于难以决策的情况，操作员可以调用一个多模型委员会。 来自多个提供商的模型独立地回答了相同的指令，彼此看不到对方的回答，然后向操作员返回各自的建议、理由和需要考量的风险。 已确认的故障被用来在代码库的其他部分搜索类似问题，并在适当的情况下添加回归测试。 智能体也可以在会话结束时提出可复用的经验教训；经批准的教训会被存储起来，供后续会话使用。 编码智能体无法访问生产数据，任何变更只有在经过预发布环境测试并获得操作员明确批准之后，才会部署到生产环境。

sents.zh: 对于难以决策的情况，操作员可以调用一个多模型委员会。

sents.zh: 智能体也可以在会话结束时提出可复用的经验教训；经批准的教训会被存储起来，供后续会话使用。

sents.en: Production data was inaccessible to the coding agents, and changes reached production only after staging and explicit operator approval.
sents.zh: 编码智能体无法访问生产数据，任何变更只有在经过预发布环境测试并获得操作员明确批准之后，才会部署到生产环境。

paragraphs.en: The clearest pattern was asymmetric delegation. The operator delegated implementation and much of its technical review, but not the authority to make consequential changes. Worker and reviewing agents could propose code, findings and persistent lessons, while the operator controlled what became durable project context and what entered production; production data was also kept outside agent reach. Control was concentrated at the points where agent outputs became persistent or operationally consequential, rather than exercised continuously through line-level inspection. This resembles Barnes et al.’s framing of agentic Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) as an authority-transfer problem, with control-plane authority separated from bounded data-plane work ( Barnes et al., 2026 ) . It also aligns with architectural tactics such as checkpoints, tool fencing and write staging for high-consequence actions ( Safin and Balta, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 最清晰的模式是非对称授权。 操作员将实施工作及其大部分技术审查授权了出去，但并未授予做出重大变更的权限。 执行和审查的智能体可以提出代码、发现结果和长期经验教训，而操作员则控制哪些内容会成为持久的项目上下文以及哪些内容会进入生产环境；生产数据也被限制在智能体的可及范围之外。 控制权集中在智能体输出变得持久或在操作上产生重大影响的关键节点上，而不是通过逐行检查持续行使控制。 这与 Barnes 等人将智能体驱动的持续集成与持续交付（CI/CD）框架视为一个权限转移问题的观点相一致，其中控制平面的权限与有限的数据平面工作相分离（Barnes et al., 2026）。 这也与一些架构策略相符，例如在后果严重操作中设置检查点、工具隔离和写入预演机制（Safin and Balta, 2026）。

sents.zh: 最清晰的模式是非对称授权。

paragraphs.en: This also changed what the operator needed to understand. She did not need to reconstruct every implementation decision, but she did need to know what each reviewing mechanism had observed, what claim its output could support and what action could follow from it. In this case, adding another reviewer moved rather than removed part of the oversight problem: the operator also had to judge the reviewer’s evidential scope and authority. RQ2 examines what happened when those supervisory signals were themselves unreliable.
paragraphs.zh: 这也改变了操作者需要理解的内容。 她不需要重构每一个实现决策，但她确实需要了解每个审查机制观察到了什么，其输出能够支持哪些主张，以及由此可以采取哪些行动。 在这种情况下，增加另一个审查员并没有消除部分监督问题，反而使其变得更加复杂：操作者还必须评估该审查员的证据范围与权限。 RQ2 探讨了当这些监督信号本身不可靠时会发生什么。

sents.en: This also changed what the operator needed to understand.
sents.zh: 这也改变了操作者需要理解的内容。

sents.en: RQ2 examines what happened when those supervisory signals were themselves unreliable.
sents.zh: RQ2 探讨了当这些监督信号本身不可靠时会发生什么。

paragraphs.en: When bugs or failures were discovered, they were used to improve later development. When a problem was confirmed, the agent was asked to fix it, look for similar problems elsewhere and record any lesson that should carry forward. The operator became particularly concerned with whether these tests could genuinely detect the failures they claimed to cover: “I don’t trust a test just because it passes.” Tests were checked by deliberately recreating targeted failures and confirming that the corresponding checks failed. This uses the broader fault-seeding intuition behind mutation testing ( Jia and Harman, 2011 ) . This is important for LLM-generated tests, because incorrect code in the prompt can substantially reduce test accuracy and bug-detection effectiveness ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Over time, failures changed not only the code but also the tests and instructions used in later work, similar to evaluation-driven development ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当发现错误或故障时，它们被用来改进后续的开发工作。 当问题得到确认时，智能体被要求修复该问题、在其他地方寻找类似的问题，并记录任何应保留的经验教训。 操作者特别关心这些测试是否真能检测出它们声称要覆盖的故障：“我不信任一个仅仅因为通过了测试而成立的测试。”测试通过故意重现目标故障并确认相应的检查失败来进行验证。 这利用了突变测试背后更广泛的故障注入直觉（Jia 和 Harman，2011）。 这对 LLM 生成的测试很重要，因为提示中的错误代码会显著降低测试的准确性和检测错误的效果（Huang 等，2026）。 随着时间的推移，故障不仅改变了代码，也改变了后续工作中使用的测试和说明，这与评估驱动开发类似（Xia 等，2025；Lyu 等，2026）。

sents.zh: 当发现错误或故障时，它们被用来改进后续的开发工作。

paragraphs.en: We also asked whether the checks accumulated through incidents and adversarial reviews covered security concerns recognized independently outside the project. The inventory was mapped against four external references that had not been consulted during its construction: the OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 API Security Risks, CWE Top 25 and relevant HIPAA Security Rule provisions ( OWASP Foundation, 2025 ; OWASP Foundation, 2023 ; The MITRE Corporation, 2025 ; Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, 2026 ) . Of 84 mapped items, 69 (82.1%) were covered by the pre-existing checks. This suggests that the system she developed had accumulated checks addressing many concerns represented in established security guidance. It does not establish full platform security. It also does not demonstrate model generalization: because the standards are public, independence from model training cannot be assumed, a concern in benchmark-contamination research ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们还询问，通过事件和对抗性审查积累的检查是否涵盖了在项目之外独立识别出的安全关注问题。 该清单与四个在构建过程中未参考过的外部参考资料进行了对照：OWASP Top 10、OWASP Top 10 API 安全风险、CWE Top 25 以及相关的 HIPAA 安全规则条款（OWASP Foundation, 2025；OWASP Foundation, 2023；The MITRE Corporation, 2025；Electronic Code of Federal Regulations, 2026）。 在 84 个经过对照的项目中，有 69 项（82.1%）已被现有的检查所覆盖。 这表明她开发的系统已积累了针对既定安全指南中所列诸多问题的检查措施。 但这并未证明整个平台是安全的。 这也未能体现模型的泛化能力：由于这些标准是公开的，因此无法假设其与模型训练无关，而这一点正是基准污染研究中的一个关注问题（Zhang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: However, the main finding was that these evaluations themselves became another fallible software layer. Several backup monitors checked whether intermediate events occurred without establishing that a usable backup actually existed. An audit stopped running without producing a failure, while another report calculated its pass rate only from checks that emitted results, allowing missing checks to disappear from the total. In the most consequential incident, a monitor incorrectly classified legitimate long-running work as a failure and repeatedly attempted an automated repair, causing operational disruption. These incidents are related to the test-oracle problem; even when a check executes, its verdict may not establish the intended outcome ( Barr et al., 2015 ) . In each case, a reassuring signal supported a stronger claim than the evidence justified.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，主要发现是这些评估本身又成为了另一个可能出错的软件层。 多个备用监控器检查了中间事件是否发生，但并未确认是否存在真正可用的备份。 一次审计在未产生故障的情况下停止运行，而另一份报告仅根据输出结果的检查计算其通过率，导致未执行的检查从总数中消失。 在最严重的事故中，一个监控器错误地将正常的长期运行任务判定为故障，并反复尝试自动修复，造成了运营中断。 这些事故与测试预言机问题有关；即使某个检查执行成功，其结果也可能无法证明预期的目标已达成（Barr 等，2015）。 在每个案例中，一个令人安心的信号所支持的结论，都超出了证据本身所能证明的范围。

paragraphs.en: These incidents highlighted four recurring concerns in this case: whether a check observed the intended outcome rather than a convenient proxy; whether there was evidence that it had actually run; whether missing or empty results remained visible; and whether its authority was limited enough to prevent an incorrect result from immediately triggering harmful action. The checks and reviewing mechanisms supported later development, but their presence or apparent success was not itself sufficient evidence of reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 这些事件凸显了本案中的四个反复出现的问题：检查是否观察到了预期的结果，而非一个便捷的替代指标；是否有证据表明该检查实际上已执行；缺失或为空的结果是否仍然可见；以及其权限是否受到足够限制，以防止错误结果立即引发有害行动。 检查和审查机制为后续开发提供了支持，但它们的存在或表面上的成功本身并不足以证明其可靠性。

sents.en: These incidents highlighted four recurring concerns in this case: whether a check observed the intended outcome rather than a convenient proxy; whether there was evidence that it had actually run; whether missing or empty results remained visible; and whether its authority was limited enough to prevent an incorrect result from immediately triggering harmful action.
sents.zh: 这些事件凸显了本案中的四个反复出现的问题：检查是否观察到了预期的结果，而非一个便捷的替代指标；是否有证据表明该检查实际上已执行；缺失或为空的结果是否仍然可见；以及其权限是否受到足够限制，以防止错误结果立即引发有害行动。

sents.en: The checks and reviewing mechanisms supported later development, but their presence or apparent success was not itself sufficient evidence of reliability.
sents.zh: 检查和审查机制为后续开发提供了支持，但它们的存在或表面上的成功本身并不足以证明其可靠性。

paragraphs.en: This case is consistent with the broader finding that coding agents reorganize SE work rather than remove it. As implementation becomes easier, more human effort moves toward defining requirements, checking results and deciding whether a change is safe to release ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) . The case adds a distinction between outcomes the operator could inspect directly and those accessible only through software-generated evidence. Staging worked well for observable behavior, while the clearest assurance failures occurred in less visible properties such as backups, audit execution, monitoring completeness and automated recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 这一案例与更广泛的发现一致，即编码智能体重新组织了软件工程工作，而非将其消除。 随着实现变得更容易，更多的人类精力转向定义需求、检查结果以及判断某项变更是否安全可发布（Lyu 等，2026）。 该案例区分了操作员可以直接检查的结果与只能通过软件生成的证据访问的结果。 分阶段操作在可观察行为方面效果良好，而最明显的保障失败则发生在较难察觉的属性中，例如备份、审计执行、监控完整性和自动恢复。

sents.en: This case is consistent with the broader finding that coding agents reorganize SE work rather than remove it.
sents.zh: 这一案例与更广泛的发现一致，即编码智能体重新组织了软件工程工作，而非将其消除。

sents.en: As implementation becomes easier, more human effort moves toward defining requirements, checking results and deciding whether a change is safe to release ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Researchers have proposed guard agents that check other agents ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , critic models that help humans identify mistakes ( McAleese et al., 2024 ) , and execution systems that preserve structured, reversible traces for meta-agent inspection and replay ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . The incidents here raise a complementary issue for meta-agent research: once supervision itself is delegated, human oversight also has to account for what the supervisor observed, what its output actually supports and what authority follows from it. In this case, additional reviewers and monitors were useful, but their outputs could not be treated as ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员提出了用于检查其他智能体的守护智能体（Xiang 等人，2025）、帮助人类识别错误的批评模型（McAleese 等人，2024），以及为元智能体的检查和重演保留结构化、可逆轨迹的执行系统（Yu 等人，2026）。 此处的事件引发了元智能体研究的一个补充问题：一旦监督本身被委托出去，人类的监督也必须考虑监督者观察到了什么、其输出实际上支持了什么，以及由此产生的权限是什么。 在这种情况下，额外的审查员和监控者确实有用，但他们的输出不能被视为绝对真理。

sents.zh: 研究人员提出了用于检查其他智能体的守护智能体（Xiang 等人，2025）、帮助人类识别错误的批评模型（McAleese 等人，2024），以及为元智能体的检查和重演保留结构化、可逆轨迹的执行系统（Yu 等人，2026）。

sents.zh: 在这种情况下，额外的审查员和监控者确实有用，但他们的输出不能被视为绝对真理。

paragraphs.en: This is a single case involving one operator, one platform and an evolving workflow. The operator was directly involved in creating both the system and its governance process, which may have led to an overly favourable interpretation. We reduced this risk by comparing the interview account with project records and focusing on concrete failures, but the evidence remains observational. The study does not establish that the workflow caused fewer defects, that the platform was secure or compliant, or that the same approach would be sufficient for other users or systems.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个单一案例，涉及一名操作员、一个平台以及一个不断演变的流程。 该操作员直接参与了系统和其治理流程的创建，这可能导致了过于有利的解读。 我们通过将访谈描述与项目记录进行比较，并重点关注具体的失败情况，降低了这一风险，但相关证据仍属观察性证据。 该研究并未证实该流程减少了缺陷、该平台安全或合规，也未证实相同的方法对其他用户或系统足够有效。

sents.en: This is a single case involving one operator, one platform and an evolving workflow.
sents.zh: 这是一个单一案例，涉及一名操作员、一个平台以及一个不断演变的流程。

sents.en: The operator was directly involved in creating both the system and its governance process, which may have led to an overly favourable interpretation.

sents.en: The study does not establish that the workflow caused fewer defects, that the platform was secure or compliant, or that the same approach would be sufficient for other users or systems.
sents.zh: 该研究并未证实该流程减少了缺陷、该平台安全或合规，也未证实相同的方法对其他用户或系统足够有效。

paragraphs.en: This case illustrates one way human control was maintained when implementation and much of its review were delegated to agents. In this workflow, control became concentrated around intended outcomes, evidence, access boundaries and consequential decisions. The same workflow also exposed a second-order assurance problem. The tests and reviewing agents introduced to support oversight could provide incomplete or misleading evidence. In this case, adding supervisory mechanisms moved part of the oversight problem to judging what those mechanisms had actually observed, what their outputs supported and what authority followed from them.
paragraphs.zh: 这个案例说明了一种在实施及其大部分审查工作都委托给智能体时，人类仍能保持控制的方式。 在这种工作流程中，控制权集中在了预期成果、证据、访问边界以及由此产生的决策方面。 同样的工作流程也暴露出了一个二阶的可靠性问题。 为支持监督而引入的测试和审查智能体可能会提供不完整或具有误导性的证据。 在这个案例中，增加监督机制将监督问题的一部分转移到了判断这些机制实际观察到了什么、其输出结果支持了什么以及由此产生了何种权限上。

sents.en: This case illustrates one way human control was maintained when implementation and much of its review were delegated to agents.
sents.zh: 这个案例说明了一种在实施及其大部分审查工作都委托给智能体时，人类仍能保持控制的方式。

paragraphs.en: Building, pre-merge review and meta-audits used Anthropic Claude models invoked through the Claude Code command-line agent. The multi-model council additionally queried Google Gemini and OpenAI GPT models through their APIs. Reviews and meta-audits were run by separately started agent instances with no access to the development conversation. The reviewing agents shared the builder’s model family, so shared blind spots are possible.
paragraphs.zh: 构建、合并前审查和元审计使用了通过 Claude Code 命令行智能体调用的 Anthropic Claude 模型。 多模型委员会还通过其 API 查询了 Google Gemini 和 OpenAI GPT 模型。 审查和元审计由单独启动的智能体实例执行，这些实例无法访问开发对话。 审查智能体与构建者使用相同的模型家族，因此可能存在共同的盲点。
